3. "پیش بمیرد چراغدان ثریا - برخی (فدا) جانم شوم که شمع افق را"
Rough: "Before the lamp of Sirius dies - I become some (sacrifice) for the candle of the horizon." Something about sacrifice, light.

4. "من نیست شدم هستی هستم همه اوست - سمع و بصر و زبان و دستم همه اوست"
Rough: "I am not, I became existence, I am all, He is everything - my hearing, sight, tongue, hand all are Him." This is about unity with divine, annihilation of self.
